name: codexrouter
description: Desktop-first single-model gateway for Codex with isolated ChatGPT accounts and usage telemetry.

scripts.check: node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/router.js && node --check src/catalog.js && node --check src/auth.js && node --check src/usage.js && node --check desktop/electron/main.cjs && node --check desktop/electron/preload.cjs && node --check desktop/electron/autostart.cjs && node --check desktop/scripts/package-bin.cjs && node --check desktop/scripts/dev.cjs && node --check desktop/scripts/dev-smoke.cjs && node --check scripts/e2e-macos.mjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.desktop:package:all: npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder -mwl
scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
